device_entry.name: PyMCA/SPEC 数据文件写入器
tags: 追加式实验记录与索引访问
device_entry.description: 用于实验扫描数据采集流程的文件写入组件，可生成类似 PyMCA/SPEC 格式的输出文件，写入测量头信息、扫描设备信息和数据点，便于后续分析、可视化与归档。
device_entry.description_en: A data-writing component used in experimental scan acquisition workflows. It generates PyMCA/SPEC-like output files, recording measurement headers, scan device information, and data points for later analysis, visualization, and archiving.

schema.description: 将采集到的扫描数据写入输出文件。
schema.description_en: Write acquired scan data to the output file.

schema.description: 写入文件头和扫描设备相关信息。
schema.description_en: Write the file header and scan device information.
